label: Midnight Chrome
description: Near-black showroom dark with an electric ice-blue primary and warm chrome-amber accent. Built for car accessories, detailing studios and audio installers, whose product photography is almost always shot inside a dark car.
notes: Every text pairing measured against WCAG AA: text/bg 16.42:1, text/surface 14.82:1, muted/bg 7.53:1, muted/surface 6.79:1, accent/bg 11.56:1, accent/surface 10.44:1, primary/bg 9.01:1. `accent` matters most — the renderer uses it for 12px meta text in ~15 places, which is where the shipped automotive themes fail (octane's primary is 3.74:1 on its own background, iron-blaze's accent 3.82:1). Both `primary` and `accent` are bright enough that SiteRenderer::readableOn() picks #111827 for text on them, giving 8.28:1 and 10.63:1 on buttons. `secondary` is an ELEVATED SURFACE here, not a text colour — do not measure it against bg. Likewise `border` and `surface` sit deliberately close to `bg`; a 3:1 divider on a dark theme reads as a harsh outline, and every shipped dark theme does the same.
